findings.fix_finding_handoff: Use $fix-finding for scripts/skills.py bridge generation: carry source explicit-only declarations, visibility/tool/path restrictions and host policy to generated metadata before discovery; refuse ambiguous policy before transactional replacement; preserve source bytes, licenses, ordinary invocation and unmanaged skills. Static host behavior remains a proof gap.
